problem: Current WNBA players can lose verified production when ESPN and WNBA Stats IDs only partially overlap, producing false zero stat cards downstream.
root_cause: The player-pool gate assumes provider ID overlap is globally safe once any one ID overlaps and then filters every WNBA Stats row by ESPN IDs.
patch: Use a WNBA-only current-roster production gate that matches by exact ID or normalized name and preserves already league-guarded slate-team production when that team's roster feed is unavailable.
